We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

As new entities and products launch, you set up the accounting so it scales, rather than patching it later.

What to Expect

 * In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

 * Operational ownership: Own day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, reconciliations, master data and bookkeeping.

 * Monthly close & reporting: Own monthly closing and recurring statutory filings (VAT, ZM, Intrastat, etc.), working closely with our tax advisors.

 * Revenue recognition: make sure usage-based revenue is recognised correctly and consistently.

 * Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

 * Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

 * Oversight: keep billing, payables and payroll postings accurate, and improve processes and systems as volume grows.

What You Bring

Must-haves

 * 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

 * Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

 * Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

 * Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

 * Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

 * Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

 * Multi-entity consolidation, or IFRS exposure.

 * Experience with post-merger integration or investor due diligence.

 * Familiar with modern finance tools (e.g. BMD, DATEV, Xero or Stripe).

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €100,000 + Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 20 min culture fit

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿

You work closely with Product/Engineering and Go-to-Market, making sure deployments are fast, stable, and repeatable across the Italian market.

º Build and roll out fonio setups in production: workflows, logic, prompts, guardrails

º Implement integrations with third-party systems (APIs, webhooks, CRM, calendar, ticketing, etc.)

º Develop smaller features and glue code to cleanly map customer cases

º Debug under production conditions: calls, flows, edge cases, fast fixes

º Build reusable templates and deployment playbooks to make setups scalable

º Deliver product feedback: bring pain points and feature gaps to the team, prioritized and concrete

Who we're looking for

º Solid coding skills: you can implement independently, not just configure

º Strong understanding of AI systems and LLMs (prompting, tool-use, RAG, failure modes)

º Workflow thinking: translate complex processes into robust, testable flows

º Experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, and common integration patterns

º Cloud fundamentals: deployments, observability, debugging in production

º Highly pragmatic working style: ship fast, make it stable, iterate

º Bonus: Voice/Telephony, n8n, TypeScript/Python, SQL, monitoring/tracing, GDPR

º Italian at native or near-native level + solid English

What we offer

º Competitive salary: €60,000-€95,000 per year

º 100% Focus Time (no regular meetings)

º Unlimited budget when the ROI is right

º Extreme speed (we ship almost daily)

º Thousands of enthusiastic customers building the product together with us

Hiring Process

 * 25 min intro

We build AI voice agents for small and medium-sized businesses so they never miss a call and can focus on the work they actually love.

Our AI handles every call automatically. But voice is just the beginning. Our vision: to build the world's first fully automated CRM.

11,000+ customers. >€15M ARR. ~30% monthly growth.

We live ownership. You're responsible for your projects and tasks end-to-end. No politics, few meetings, direct feedback. At fonio you'll build alongside the smartest and most ambitious people around.

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

 * Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

 * Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

 * Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

 * Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

 * German, fluent English

 * Basic technical skills and real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy clicking through a platform until you understand it, and you're not scared of webhooks, APIs or phone settings.

 * You like solving puzzles: "How do I build this for this customer?" excites you

 * You explain things simply and stay patient with non-technical customers, by phone or video

 * Structured: you can run several onboardings in parallel without dropping anything

 * Hands-on and quick to learn. You take initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna

What We Offer

 * €50,000-55,000

 * You'll learn AI and voice tech faster than anywhere else, with a real path into Customer Success, Solutions or Forward Deployment

 * Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

 * The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more

 * Need a tool, course or book? It's yours. No approval loops.

 * Your setup, your choice: pick the gear you want to work with

 * A product customers actually love: 4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google and OMR. It mostly sells itself.

 * Onsite in Vienna with a team that's here to do the best work of their careers

 

Hiring Process
